claim: Funding-conditioned features (C2) improve out-of-sample forecasting of next-24h realized volatility/variance vs RV-only baseline (B1) on an admissible cached Hyperliquid panel, with metric QLIKE and pre-registered materiality/inference criteria.

hyperliquid_candles.coverage_note: Cached admissible unauthenticated candleSnapshot files with sidecar .accessed.json/.sha256. Ex-ante audit (pre-outcome): 2025-11..2026-04 month files are empty for all candidate coins; 2026-05..2026-10 contain data for 9 core coins. ADA has 2026-05..2026-10 only; candidate universe fixed ex ante below.

hyperliquid_funding.coverage_note: Cached admissible unauthenticated fundingHistory; per-coin coverage verified ex ante to span panel window for included coins.

panel.universe_selection_rule_ex_ante: Use cached-admissible coins with complete 1h candle coverage and funding coverage for 2026-05..2026-10: AVAX,BNB,BTC,DOGE,ETH,LINK,SOL,SUI,XRP (9 coins). ADA excluded ex ante because candle cache lacks 2025-11..2026-04 and full 12-month coverage is unavailable; 2026-05..2026-10-only ADA not required and would alter fixed universe post-handoff rationale, so core 9-coin set is frozen. No selection based on outcomes.
panel.frequency: 1h decision points aligned to available candles/funding
panel.target_definition: Forward realized variance over next 24 hourly log returns: RV_{t,t+24h} = sum_{i=1}^{24} r_{t+i}^2, r = log(close_t/close_{t-1}), computed causally from future closes in horizon only for label; requires complete 24 future 1h returns.

feature_definitions.rv1h: sum of squared trailing 1h log return at t (trailing only)
feature_definitions.rv24h: sum of squared trailing 24 1h log returns ending at t
feature_definitions.rv168h: sum of squared trailing 168 1h log returns ending at t
feature_definitions.funding_rate: latest known fundingRate at or before t (as-of merge, backward)
feature_definitions.premium: latest known premium at or before t (as-of merge, backward)
feature_definitions.ema_dist: close_t / EMA24(close)_t - 1, EMA computed causally on trailing closes

models.B1: RV-only baseline: OLS/linear predictor of log(target+eps) using trailing RV features (rv1h,rv24h,rv168h) with train-only fit; predictions clipped to positive for QLIKE.
models.C2: Funding-conditioned: OLS/linear predictor of log(target+eps) using B1 features + funding_rate + abs_funding + premium + ema_dist with train-only fit; predictions clipped to positive for QLIKE.

metric_definition: QLIKE(y, yhat) = mean(y/yhat - log(y/yhat) - 1) over valid pairs with y>0, yhat>0; lower is better.

materiality_gate.relative_reduction_definition: 100 * (QLIKE_B1 - QLIKE_C2) / QLIKE_B1 on pooled paired test observations; positive favors C2.
materiality_gate.ci_definition: 95% block-bootstrap CI on paired (QLIKE_B1 - QLIKE_C2) improvement or on alt-base diff as pre-specified implementation-consistent; CI must exclude zero in favor of C2 for pass.

split_scheme.method: chronological by timestamp with symbol-pooled observations; 7-day embargo between train and each test block and between test blocks where applicable
split_scheme.selection_rule: Use last contiguous eligible period partitioned into 3 non-overlapping 30-day test blocks separated by >=7-day embargo; remaining earlier data is train (and not used for tuning on test). Exact block boundaries recorded in build/eval artifacts from available timestamps before outcome scoring.

hard_inadmissible_if: fewer than 5 paired instruments in evaluation
fewer than 3 non-overlapping 30-day test blocks with >=7-day embargo
